title: Aerin'Dar
summary: Aerin’Dar activates pairs of golem guards as the fight progresses.
overview: Aerin’Dar activates pairs of golem guards as the fight progresses.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Two golems activate at each of 80%, 60%, 40% and 20% health. They choose targets from Aerin’Dar’s hate list.
At 20%, the named golem Rhalgon also activates. Reserve enough tanks and healing for the largest final wave.
Control each pair before driving the boss through the next health threshold.
If Aerin’Dar heals back to 98%, the golems repopulate and the health stages reset. Defeat the dragon and approach the planar projection.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
